darshanTypes.name: General Darshan (Sarva Darshanam)
darshanTypes.description: Free general admission queue through standard holding bays with holy prasadam.

darshanTypes.name: Special Quick Darshan (Sheegra Darshanam)
darshanTypes.description: Dedicated priority bypass line with accelerated sanctum entry and special laddu prasadam.

darshanTypes.name: Senior Citizen & Specially-Abled Darshan
darshanTypes.description: Battery-operated buggy transport assistance with ramp access and zero-stairway movement.

darshanTypes.name: Suprabhata & Abhishekam Special Entry
darshanTypes.description: Early morning Vedic chanting ritual viewing with traditional sacred theertham and vastram blessings.

festivals.name: Maha Shivaratri & Brahmotsavam Grand Celebrations
festivals.description: Annual week-long Brahmotsavam procession featuring sacred Rathotsavam chariot festival and 24-hour continuous darshan.
festivals.specialAnnouncement: Free prasadam distribution counters expanded to 8 bays. Senior citizen battery carts active around the clock.

festivals.name: Vaikuntha Ekadashi Holy Gate Opening
festivals.description: Auspicious passage through North Gateway (Vaikuntha Dwaram) with continuous special Vedic recitations.
festivals.specialAnnouncement: Online quota pre-booking mandatory for morning slots.
